response: Yes, diffusion-weighted echo-planar MR imaging can help predict different histologic subtypes of primary parotid gland tumors. This imaging technique can provide information on the tumor's water diffusion characteristics, which can vary among different tumor types. By analyzing the apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values, it is possible to differentiate between various histologic subtypes, such as benign and malignant tumors, and even among specific types like pleomorphic adenoma, Warthin tumor, and adenoid cystic carcinoma.
